title: Customer Service Representative
description:
Our client is one of the largest logistics and warehousing providers in the country, providing high-value product transportation, wireless inventory-controlled warehousing, and household goods moving and storage. Company has several fleets including high-end auto transportation, fitness distribution, aerospace, heavy haul, and nationwide warehousing/storage.

They are looking for a CUSTOMER SERVICE REPRESENTATIVE!
TEMP TO HIRE
$23./hr, IN OFFICE M-F 8-5pm

This individual will work to manage every relocation in an expert, cheerful, and friendly manner while identifying and solving unique family move-related issues. Proactively assess service re­quirements, coordinate multi-supplier solutions, and ensure client satisfaction through controlled consistent process management.

Responsibilities:
  • Work closely with our sales staff and operations planners and dispatchers to insure we deliver the highest level of quality service available.
  • Responsible for all daily activity related to the successful relocation of household goods.
  • Obtains orders, gathers complete customer information, and quotes client orders.
  • Prepare estimates and coordinate third party services.
  • Determine hauler and pattern of service utilizing United's guide.
  • Create and update customer profiles.
  • Determine haulers through pattern of service system.
  • Register orders, print tickets, and bills of lading to operations.
  • Send correspondence to client, confirming move date.
  • Post-move quality calls.
  • Prepare driver paperwork and client reports as required.
  • Ensure invoicing accuracy to client.
  • Initiate quick claim process
  • Provide solutions to customer issues.
  • Assist other team members as needed.
  • Decision making/ problem solving responsibility for non-revenue related issues such as third party service issues, quick claim settlements and date extensions.

Experience:

  • A minimum 2 years' customer service experience in the transportation industry required
  • Logistics experience preferred
  • Competent computer skills, including Microsoft Office Suite and Google G Suite
  • Candidate must be able to communicate effectively at all levels of the organization
  • Must be organized
  • Strong written and verbal communications skills
  • Proven track record of working in a team environment and autonomously

Key Competencies
  • Partnering and teamwork
  • Ability to work with little oversight
  • Ability to place 30 transactions (new orders) per month
  • Strong attention to detail
  • Very organized I Methodical
  • Problem solving
  • Excellent telephone communication skills, have a clear and pleasant speaking voice
  • Team oriented and personally committed to continuous improvement
  • Demonstrated ability to interface effectively and positively with all members of the or­ganization
  • Computer literacy and typing skills for basic Microsoft Office and Google G Suite applications
  • Must be able to travel occasionally, usually day trips to visit with clients
Benefits: Health Insurance, Vacation and PTO available after completion of required hours worked.

title: Health Insurance - Licensed
description:
Our client, a third party contact center, provides Medicare and ACA Sales and Broker Support for a several health insurance providers. The ideal candidate should have excellent communication skills (including proper grammar), have a customer-focused attitude and be sales oriented.
  • Hourly pay rate for Licensed Agents with experience is $21.50 per hour. Training and work is in the office. Office located in Blue Bell.
  • Schedules differ by program - Day and Evening Shift/Weekend and limited remote work available; first come first serve
  • Program Offerings - Year round/August to December/August to May/Weekend only (9 week training M-F before remote weekend work available)
  • Benefits - self paid benefit options are available through agency until converted to client's payroll
Licensed Agent role and responsibilities :
  • Answer inbound calls from Prospects, Existing Members and Brokers
    • Provide sales consultation to include needs analysis, plan comparison and Provider and RX look-up.
    • Schedule Seminar Reservations, Broker Appointments and Process Fulfillment Request using documented procedures.
    • Complete Telephonic Enrollment
    • Provide Broker Support (assist broker with Appointment process, provide application status, etc.)
    • Update CRM and document call outcomes
  • Complete outbound calls to prospects and members based on Clients needs (ex: Follow-Up Sales Calls and Member Retention)
Requirements :
  • Must have active PA Accident & Health license
  • Prior experience selling Medicare Advantage or ACA plans (required)
  • Prior Call Center experience and/or experience assisting clients via phone support (preferred)

title: Customer Service Non-Licensed/Enrollment
description:
Our Call Center client located in Blue Bell is looking for professionals interested in assisting with Affordable Care Act and/or seasonal open enrollment.
  • Salary: $18 (non licensed) to $20 (newly licensed-no cost to you) per hour
  • Location: Blue Bell, In office
  • Hours/Schedule: Options available - 8am to 11pm are the call center hours, some weekend and remote work (limited)
  • Duration: 5 to 10 months could extend or convert to client payroll
  • Benefits: Self paid through agency and once converted to client payroll
BONUS: Option to become a licensed agent - training materials, instruction, exam and reciprocal licenses paid for by company - salary would bump to $20 once licensed received from the state.
Details - no out of pocket costs to you:
  • Client pays for study materials ($300)
  • You put in 20-40 hours of study time on your own - 1-2 weeks
  • Paid 1 day class 8 hours (you get $80 for the day) with instructor to offer test taking tips and review material; fist come first serve
    • June 17
    • June 30
    • July 7
  • Schedule and pay for the state licensing exam ($55 savings)
  • If you pass, they cover cost of reciprocal licenses ($50 to $200 per state)
  • If you don't pass, you may be considered for a non-licensed role:
Responsibilities:
- Answer inbound calls and emails
-Update and document all information in CRM system
-Educate customers on various plans, if licensed only
-Follow up on questions or transfer to a licensed agent
-Escalate calls or situations that require immediate attention
-Highly detailed oriented
-Excellent communication skills
-Able to handle large volume of calls in a fast-paced environment
-Punctual with excellent attendance
-Flexible with hours
-Quick to learn new software packages
-Team player/collaborative
-Empathetic demeanor

title: Home Health Aide
description:
We are assisting our client to find a Home Health Aide to join their organization on a direct hire basis. Must be able to commute to Manahawkin, NJ.

Our client helps their patients live better, healthier lives and help each other succeed. With a culture rooted in connection and collaboration, the employees are team members. Here, competitive benefits are just the beginning. It's also about how they support each other and how they show up for their community. Together, they keep getting better - advancing their mission to transform healthcare and serve as a leader of positive change.

  • Salary: $18-$21 per hour (equates to $38K=$43K annually)
  • Hours: 8:30 to 5 M-F and 1 weekend a month, must work 2 of 6 holidays annually
  • Benefits: Comprehensive health benefits, PTO, travel reimbursement, 401K (Match) and tuition reimbursement

Responsibilities:

Provide in-home, para-professional services necessary for caring for patients' personal needs under the direction of the RN.

  • Perform and/or assist patient with personal care activities, such as, baths, showers, skin and hair care, and oral hygiene. Assure universal safety precautions and direction on the care plan are followed when providing care. Provide care that meets the patient's needs.
  • Notify RN of any changes in patient condition observed in a timely manner and document appropriately.
  • Record all required information on patient chart completely and accurately. Assure documentation is completed per organization protocol.
  • Assist patient with transfer and ambulating. Perform range of motion exercises. Assure all activities are performed safely and follow the principles of good body mechanics.
  • Perform general housekeeping of patient's area and change patient's bed linens. Assist family with light housekeeping activities, such as dusting, vacuuming, damp mopping, etc.
  • Assist client with self-administration of oral medication/s. Remind patient when to take medication/s.
  • Prepare simple meals in accordance with dietary instructions and assist patient with eating if necessary.
  • Assist with of foley catheter and colostomy care to ensure proper hygiene. Assist patient with changing colostomy bags. Perform peri care. Measure urine. Assist with ostomy care and assure skin is clean around stoma.
  • Other duties and/or projects as assigned. Demonstrate flexibility with job responsibilities in all areas.
  • Adheres to Organizational competencies and standards of behavior.
  • Lifts a minimum of 50 lbs., pushes and pulls a minimum of 50 lbs. and stands a minimum of 8 hours a day.

Qualifications:

Education, Knowledge, Skills and Abilities Required:

  • Good Customer Service Skills

Education, Knowledge, Skills and Abilities Preferred:

  • Home Care Experience

Licenses and Certifications Required:

  • Homemaker - HHA Certification.
  • Valid Driver's License from a USA state

title: Senior Buyer
description:
Our client, a decades-old manufacturer in the aerospace industry, is seeking an experienced Senior Buyer to manage the procurement of materials, supplies, and services to support operational goals out of their Pennsauken, NJ office.

This role is responsible for vendor management, contract negotiation, and ensuring cost-effective purchasing strategies while maintaining quality and compliance standards.

Key Responsibilities

  • Negotiate pricing, delivery terms, and contracts with suppliers

  • Identify, evaluate, and develop reliable sources of supply

  • Manage procurement processes, including bid evaluation and supplier selection

  • Maintain strong vendor relationships and monitor supplier performance

  • Support production and operational needs through effective purchasing strategies

  • Ensure accuracy and integrity of purchasing data and documentation

  • Collaborate cross-functionally with operations, accounting, and quality teams

  • Resolve procurement issues and ensure timely order fulfillment

Qualifications

  • Bachelor's degree or equivalent experience required

  • 4–7 years of procurement experience in a manufacturing environment

  • Strong knowledge of purchasing principles, supplier negotiations, and supply chain processes

  • Experience with ERP/MRP systems and Microsoft Office

  • Ability to interpret technical drawings and specifications is a plus

  • Excellent communication, organization, and problem-solving skills
  • Ability to travel up to 10%
  • ​Must be available to work M-F onsite at their Pennsauken, NJ location. This is NOT a remote position.

Additional Information

  • Salary: $85k-$115k (depending on experience)
  • ​Competitive benefits

title: Operations Supervisor
description:
Our client in the biotech industry located in The Oaks area is looking to hire an Operations Supervisor to oversee all warehouse operations across shifts, ensuring smooth workflow, accurate inventory, strong documentation, and compliance with safety and GMP standards. This role provides leadership to warehouse staff, supports cross-department coordination, and drives continuous improvement initiatives. The Operations Supervisor plays a critical role in maintaining operational readiness in preparation for company growth.
  • Salary: $60-$70K with annual performance and compensation reviews
  • Benefits: Medical, Dental, Vision Insurance, PTO and paid holidays, Growth opportunities as the company expands
KEY RESPONSIBILITIES:
Operations:
  • Oversee and coordinate all warehouse operations across both AM and PM shifts to ensure efficient workflow and uninterrupted support of production. (Hours of operation 6am – 10pm)
  • Manage daily execution of receiving, labeling, staging, storage, consumable preparation, and outbound shipments.
  • Coordinate closely with Production to ensure availability of consumables, supplies, and equipment.
  • Oversee handling and storage of blood containers, raw materials, and temperature-sensitive items.
  • Ensure the warehouse remains clean, organized, and inspection-ready at all times.
Team Leadership & Oversight:
  • Provide direct leadership and accountability for Warehouse Leads on both shifts.
  • Maintain regular presence across shifts to ensure consistency in expectations, performance, and communication.
  • Conduct daily huddles to review staffing, priorities, safety concerns, and equipment status.
  • Address performance, attendance, and workflow issues promptly and professionally.
  • Lead onboarding, training, and ongoing development of warehouse staff.
  • Maintain training materials, SOP familiarity, and competency tracking.
Communication & Collaboration:
  • Serve as the operational bridge between CEO, Warehouse, Production, Quality, Maintenance, and Office/HR teams.
  • Communicate inventory shortages, delays, equipment issues, or staffing concerns in real time.
  • Support cross-functional planning to align operational needs with production and quality requirements.
  • Escalate risks, issues, or deviations promptly with clear recommendations .
Safety and Workplace Standards :
  • Enforce safety policies, GMP requirements, and OSHA regulations.
  • Conduct routine safety inspections and ensure proper PPE usage.
  • Report hazards, incidents, or equipment concerns immediately.
  • Promote a safe, organized, and professional warehouse environment.
REQUIRED SKILLS & QUALIFICATIONS :
  • 3–5+ years of operations supervisory experience in warehouse, logistics, biotech, or GMP environments.
  • Strong leadership and communication skills.
  • Highly organized with strong documentation accuracy.
  • Hands-on mindset with ability to thrive in fast-paced environments
  • Problem-solving and decision-making abilities.
  • Basic computer literacy.
  • Bachelors degree
PHYSICAL REQUIREMENTS :
  • Ability to stand and walk for extended periods.
  • Ability to lift 40+ lbs.
  • Comfortable working in cold or warm environments.
SUCCESS INDICATORS :
  • Smooth, consistent operations across both shifts.
  • Well-trained warehouse leads capable of independent management.
  • High accuracy in inventory, documentation, and equipment flow.
  • Strong communication across all departments.
  • Clean, safe, organized warehouse environment.
  • Quick resolution of operational issues.
